contract.period_reference: mean of three preceding annotated intervals, not raw anchors or fitted tempo
contract.common_domain: closed hull of both five-point templates expanded by three frames; all frames must be available
contract.overlap_exclusion: neighboring query windows within either template may not share frames; cross-template overlap allowed
contract.shared_score: maximum over one offset of mean beat logit at all five shifted points
contract.independent_score: mean of five individually maximized beat logits; diagnostic comparator only
contract.downbeat_readout: mean at the five points with beat-selected shared offset; never combined with beat score
contract.sign_convention: positive margin favors left template, not necessarily correct tempo
contract.constant_context: entire three-interval prefix and four-interval suffix are in annotated constant regions without change points
